name: Switch
summary: A checkbox that takes effect the moment you flip it — drawn as a track and a thumb, so state reads from position as well as color, with the role="switch" variant alongside it.
demoNote: Flip example 2 and the confirmation arrives politely, without renaming the control. Example 4's locked switch still takes focus and still says why — that is the difference between aria-disabled and disabled.

contract.useWhen: An on/off that applies immediately, with the thumb as the second cue.
keyboard: one stop — the drawn track is not focusable
submits the form, as on any checkbox. It does not toggle
failureModes: the track color as the only cue, so the state is carried by color alone (SC 1.4.1)
role=switch reached for by default — it announces inconsistently in older JAWS
a switch that needs a Save button, which should have been a checkbox
the real input hidden with display:none, which removes the keyboard route
disabled rather than aria-disabled when the person needs to know why
api: AC.createSwitch(root, options) -> { set, state, refresh, input, destroy }
